about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, exhaust and underbody. We work out of West Columbia and the towns around it.

reviews.author: James Orban III
reviews.text: I cannot thank them enough for working on my car. My 2016 GTI needed extensive work (engine sump replacement, clutch replacement, & rear main seal replacement) and most shops would not touch it. After being turned down or given extremely high quotes by three other local shops I got referred to Metro. Shawn was so easy to talk to and quoted me based on how long VW states the work should take which was significantly cheaper than any other shop I had talked to. The car had to get towed to the shop and while I didn't get to talk with Shawn when I dropped it off, his wife Shannon was so nice and welcoming. The tech working on my car was knowledgable and no one there tried to upsell anything. These people are car enthusiasts and will take care of your car whether it's stock or modified. I would highly recommend a call to this shop if you need any work done on any car, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Zach Noel
reviews.text: I recently sent in my 2015 Camaro SS for some extensive work, pulling the engine and transmission for a refresh + a camshaft and transmission work. Shawn the owner and his staff are very knowledgeable, professional and kind. I enjoyed working with them. They got the job done quickly for a fair price. I would use them again and recommend them to you.

reviews.author: Jill Zingle
reviews.text: The crew here does amazing work. Prices are better than other places I've checked out for car repairs in the past. Satisfaction guaranteed. Five + stars.

reviews.author: Jay Green
reviews.text: Shawn and his technicians not only always get the job done they also get your car fixed and ready in a timely manner and unlike a lot of other mechanics the quoted prices are always what you are charged no added fee or price increases last minute. One of the only mechanics I trust in SC.

reviews.author: Eddie
reviews.text: Sean and his team are the best people I've worked with. They worked with me to diagnose and fix any issue my car was having, including slight fabrication. They kept me in the loop and did what they could to work within my budget even allowing me to source parts. They're great people and even after one mishap I brought it back, and it was ready within a day. Even after six months I've not had a single issue and I can't be thankful enough for the work that they've done. I know my car was a total pain for anybody to work on, and I'm beyond grateful for their work ethic.

reviews.author: lavais clark
reviews.text: Great place to take A vehicle in Need of Some serious or minor repairs. BMWs are Even Welcomed here Great service and Great Turn around times, however it’s a Very Busy shop. Been here a Few times with our vehicle and plan on bringing the others soon Sean Definitely Knows His Stuff

reviews.author: Destination Unknown
reviews.text: I chose to call Metro Auto works due to their excellent reviews and I'm glad I did. My call was answered by a very knowledgeable young lady who was able to provide me with a quote and an available date to work on my vehicle in the first call. Might I add.... That the quote was less that multiple other shops I called. They were able to get my vehicle in the next week and was able to fix the issue in one day! When speaking with the mechanic he was very knowledgeable! When I picked my vehicle up it drove like a dream. The job was a messy one but they took the time to wipe down the area where the mess was before returning the car. I highly recommend this shop!!!

reviews.author: Jim John
reviews.text: I originally took my SUBARU to McDaniel's SUBARU where they were no help at all. They charged me for a diagnostic and offered no solution. The subaru had a misfire in cylinder 4. I called Metro Auto Works and Shawn answered, he seemed like he knows his cars. I immediately had the car towed there. He took about a day and fixed the problem that McDaniels created when they overtighted my spark plug in cylinder 4. Thank you Shawn and I will be returning soon for more business.

reviews.author: Mike Houston
reviews.text: Dropped off a 2.0 for a 2014 Hyundai Genesis Coupe here after another shop had it for over 3 months and never touched it. Metro Autoworks kept me updated through our the whole process of the machine shop and the building of the engine. Will look to them again for any other work needed. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Keven S
reviews.text: Shawn was a pleasure to work with. Very down to Earth and pays attention to detail. I had my headers specially coated and Shawn took that into consideration protecting them as much as he could so they wouldn’t get scratched. Very phenomenal work that I appreciate a lot. I would highly recommend his work, I had a great first experience coming here to get work done. Thank you again!! A+++++

reviews.author: Malachi Meloni
reviews.text: Great staff.. Amazingly fast service. Honest and fair pricing. Not my first visit and where I plan to come the next time it's needed.

reviews.author: Eli Scriver
reviews.text: Couldn't find someone to fix my car because the radiator support beam was bent and every shop I called told me I needed to get it straightened with a body shop before coming to a mechanic. Body shops are booked MONTHS out. Took me 40 phone calls until I found Shawn who immediately jumped on and started looking at parts while on the phone with me, agreed to bang out the beam, got me parts cheaper than anyone, and prioritized my car so I could get to work. Parts came in on a Monday and I had the car by Wednesday morning. He helped me out majorly when I was in a tight spot, he is honest and transparent with pricing, and his compassion is unmatched. He did what everyone said was impossible and I am so grateful. Cute dogs too :)

reviews.author: Briana
reviews.text: Professional services. If you want honesty, instruction, and understanding of your car/ or what’s going on with it this is the place you want to trust with your vehicle. From the first time calling they were understanding of what I tried to explain I thought was wrong. When they corrected the issue they not only explained the problem, but showed me the problem on the exact part causing the issue. Unbeatable prices in the area . I Recommended this shop.

reviews.author: Daniel Marsh
reviews.text: Stellar Mechanics with friendly and trustworthy service. Haven't had too many issues with my car but when I do I take it to them and that's the end of it. Very knowledgeable staff. Contact them for anything from fabrication, wiring, full vehicle builds, modification installs, or just routine maintenance. They do a great job for a fair price. I wouldn't be driving 45min every time unless I really felt it was worth it, and it is.

reviews.author: bryce garrett
reviews.text: Took my car to Shawn with a clutch and flywheel replacement and couldn’t have been more impressed. Quick work with great pricing. I recommend it to anyone looking to get work done to their vehicle, these guys know what they’re doing.

reviews.author: Jelani Negron
reviews.text: I only spoke with them on the phone and got my questions answered! No hassle, no bs, incredibly affordable price, so far the most competitive in price (by a lot!!!! At the very least 65% cheaper!!!) cannot wait to get my stuff taken care off. The owner is very knowledgeable in performance vehicles and very versatile (not just brand oriented). Lastly which was the cherry on top, he advised me to shop around for the specific parts I’d like to upgrade because of the difference in price mark ups so I can get the best deal!!! Again this was my first time talking to this shop and I have nothing but ask what is the catch because it sounds to good to be true!

reviews.author: Brenda Viera
reviews.text: My niece recommended Metro for a check of my transmission which had a leak. I asked them to do a complete review of my vehicle and they were back to me within 2 hours of their findings. 48 hours later they called to say my vehicle was ready. I will definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: AJ Rosario
reviews.text: Sean and Shannon have a great mechanic shop the community can count on. They helped me rebuild an old Ford truck engine and stood by their word whenever I needed any assistance. They are a power couple who work well as a team. I highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Daniel Alo
reviews.text: Excellent service. I usually do my own work on my car, but being in the transition of moving states, all my tools are in storage. I searched around for a place I would feel comfortable working out a problem I had on my single-turbo 370z and glad I chose Metro Autoworks. Great communication with Nick and prompt, professional service...now I'm back on the road and enjoying my Z again. Would take my car there again for more work.

reviews.author: Reese LeBlanc
reviews.text: Shawn and his team are top notch. They got my vehicle in quickly, discovered a second major secondary problem and had both fixed ahead of schedule for a very fair price. I will return for any other needs!

reviews.author: Cynara Wattley-Liburd
reviews.text: I brought my vehicle to Metro Auto on a recommendation by My nephew. I was pleasantly surprised by the attention to detail and expertise of the staff. They were punctual and diligent with the service. They also kept me informed about the progress of my vehicle and future repair recommendation. I highly recommend this service if you want things done right in a timely manner.

reviews.author: SJ Meyer
reviews.text: I have known Shawn for 30 years. He is a wonderful mechanic, an extremely polite and professional man, and he is honest. I highly recommend Metro AutoWorks for any and all your vehicle repairs. You won't be disappointed!!

reviews.author: James Newman
reviews.text: If you want real, this is the place to be. Shawn is completely knowledgeable, adept and plentifully capable to handle all sorts of problems with your (race)car. While sometimes communication and temper can get beween ME and him, he is simply professional and knowledgeable and Metro is where you need to be.

reviews.author: Kelley M
reviews.text: Not only did Shawn work around my schedule, but he was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. Metro Autoworks was extremely efficient! I will definitely recommend this shop to everyone I know and will definitely return for future services.

reviews.author: Stephen Young
reviews.text: Meant to leave this review a few months ago but better late than never. Needed a clutch replaced on my 2005 g35 coupe. I saw this shop come up a few times on different forums so I stopped in and and they gave me a quote and time to complete the job. Dropped it off at 11am and had it back at 6 pm. Been driving on it since October 2016 with no issues. Will definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: Kiki
reviews.text: If you have any car needs make sure you take it to Metro Auto works. Shawn was soooo helpful and honest I took my car in for a transmission problem ( so I thought) shawn look over my car and gave me some great information and I was on my way. Thank you so much shawn for your help and your honesty.

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.text: Excellent guys and great service! I wanted a one off exhaust made for my car that other shops said couldn't be done; Metro Autoworks took care of it without hesitation! Will be returning for more and highly recommend them to friends/family! Thanks Guys keep up the excellent work!

reviews.author: Noah Weatherford
reviews.text: Shawn does awesome work and actually stands behind it. I literally reccomend him and his shop to anyone, from an oil change to an engine replacement. I wont let many people work on my cars, but I trust that after it comes back from Metro Autoworks, that the work is done right the first time.

reviews.author: Johnathan Moody
reviews.text: This is a great place for auto repairs. These guys always seems to do whatever they can so you won't go broke on repairs. I have a little more work to get done, and surely will be getting it done them ASAP! I would surely recommend metro auto repair to everyone. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Jerren Porphy
reviews.text: The owner Shawn is an awesome fella. Great group of knowledgeable and resourceful techs. I would highly recommend metro autoworks! They can do it all from a general service to a full turbo kit.

reviews.author: Don Taylor
reviews.text: Been coming here for years, and Shawn is the only person I'd trust with my car. Best service in town, at prices that are hard to beat. 10/10 would recommend!!

reviews.author: Radcliffe N
reviews.text: I came in for an engine swap. Everything was done in a timely manner. Shawn explained every single detail I needed to know and was very helpful. I will recommend this shop to anyone. I was. Very satisfied with the customer service and quality of the work done.

reviews.author: Daniel Bukszar
reviews.text: This is the first time I use Metro Autoworks for any type of service as I do most everything myself. But this was a bigger job than my driveway could handle. I originally had my vehicle towed to a Different shop right down the street From Metro Autoworks that specializes in the type of vehicle I own. I was told By that first shop, they could get started on it the morning after it was towed. My car sat for 2 weeks and 1 day and was never even diagnosed or looked at. After several attempts to get them to to give me a promise completion date, I decided to get my SUV and take it to Metro Autoworks. They were able to work me in within a few days and had good communication the entire process. They gave me options as to different ways to get the repair done, that fit in to my budget. They did a quality job and charged a fair price for the work that was done. All in all, I am very pleased with the outcome and the savings over what the other shop originally quoted, might I add, with out even looking at the vehicle. I would definitely recommend the guys and gal at Metro Autoworks for their quality work and fair pricing. Thanks!

reviews.author: James Frush-Marple
reviews.text: I have an old car and that is only worth putting so much into. The good folks at Metro AutoWorks presented me with several different options and even talked to me about how I could do some of it myself. They definitely went about and beyond, operating differently than most any other auto shop I've ever been to, in the very best of ways.

reviews.author: Justin Rodgers
reviews.text: Very honest and knowledgeable auto shop that will shoot it to you straight. Offers many options to stay within your budget. Shawn and his staff have a great thing going!

reviews.author: Shawn Scott
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable and trustworthy. Committed to customer satisfaction. Highly recommend. I will save you the time looking for a automotive technician. This is best place period. Offers discounts to military and first responders. That tells you a lot about the owner.

reviews.author: Bryson Campbell
reviews.text: I took my lexus here and it was in need of a throttle body. Well it does have a 1jz swap in it so I knew it would take some time. My car sat there. SAT THERE! For 3 months. I really believe that Sean looked once for the part then just left it. So I had to take it upon myself to find the part. It took me a week to find it the part after talking to another company. It was back on the road after 3 weeks of me searching and finding. While also there I had to drop off the throttle body and wanted to check on my car and noticed that they had back another car into my front bumper. So I would strongly suggest to not bring your car here.

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.text: I can honestly say I've NEVER had a better experience with a shop to date, From the knowledge the Shawn and his team have, to the way I never felt out of the loop or confused when he explained what the issues were. No fluff no frills great prices and amazing service. Think I've found a home

reviews.author: Josh Pamias
reviews.text: Courteous, friendly people that know what they are doing!! They were able to diagnose the problems with my vehicle and fix it all within a days time. Will recommend them and use again in the future for any further issues that arise. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: Ryan Arms
reviews.text: I own a turbo silverado and recently got an exhaust run all the way out the back w a vibrant muffler. After driving it around for a couple weeks now I can say that I am happy with it; looks good, sounds great, would come back and recomend.

reviews.author: Brad Chavis
reviews.text: Always a pleasure dealing with Shawn! Very knowledgeable and great pricing. Would recommend to anyone! Will not find a better person to work on your ride

reviews.author: Emily Terikaem
reviews.text: This shop has been able to fit my car repairs in when I've needed. Has been fair in pricing and communicates well on what the issue is and what needs to be done.

reviews.author: Eric Gilfus
reviews.text: Shawn at Metro Autoworks is my go to for anything automotive. Not only does Metro Autoworks service cars, they can help get you the best deals in town (and online) for the products you want. From OEM parts to aftermarket products they have you covered. Don’t think twice. Call today to set up your appointment.

reviews.author: ethan campbell
reviews.text: Excellent customer service and professionalism got my car done in a very timely manner with no complications. Cant say enough about the guys and their experience in this feild 10/10 definitely recommended for all you're automotive needs

reviews.author: Josh DeGroat
reviews.text: After years of dealing with Shawn, I can honestly say I will never take my car(s) anywhere but Metro. I’m glad to have this shop directly between my job and home.

reviews.author: Gina Heinz
reviews.text: Take my 06 BMW here all the time! So great that now I'm taking it to them for simple services like oil changes as well! Love these people!

reviews.author: Stephen Prahl
reviews.text: Just had my third vehicle repaired by Shawn and his team. Quick turnaround, fair prices and the great service, what more could you ask for?

reviews.author: Henry Rock
reviews.text: Car runs great, we appreciate the service, and the fact that all the parts are under warranty, I will bring all of my cars back to them, job well done.

reviews.author: Christina R
reviews.text: The owner is very friendly and knowledgeable. Would not take my car anywhere else. Lucky to have someone like him in the community!

reviews.author: Ramtin Behipour
reviews.text: The only mechanic I'll be using for the foreseeable future. Definitely check them out! They're honest, transparent, and present multiple options for parts where applicable to save you money.

reviews.author: True Wonders LLC
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, saved me money, friendly, thorough and overall great service. Will continue to use them. Got me back to servicing our community with my business.

reviews.author: Shannon Boothby
reviews.text: I have nothing but great things to say about this shop and the willingness to go above and beyond to make sure the customer is satisfied. Awesome pricing, quick work, and good location.

reviews.author: Luis Gonzalez
reviews.text: Friendly and polite and amazing going in depth with the details of my vehicle, Very satisfied with the service highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jonathan Witt
reviews.text: Friendly and knowledgeable mechanics They will not scam you for money I always get my car serviced their.

reviews.author: Bruce McMillan
reviews.text: I have had multiple vehicles in for service, and performance upgrades and the Team at Metro is simply Amazing.

reviews.author: Davis Clark
reviews.text: Honest, Fair, Fast and Friendly. They actually look for ways to help you save money. No B.S. Good People!

reviews.author: Havies Hanna
reviews.text: My little 5.3 still ticking and smoking, but a lesson learned. I don't know what went wrong with my motor build.

reviews.author: GaryKnoll WARHORSEphotography
reviews.text: Thanks! no Issue at all !! I though I was reviewing someone else to many windows open. my sincerest apologies
